info.name: CollabBoard Assignment 02 REST API
info.description: Deterministic access-scoping verification for the JWT-protected in-memory CollabBoard API. Run from a clean server restart.

exec: pm.test('health is ok', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ok'); });

pm.test('User B is registered', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('userBToken', body.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('userBId', body.user.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', body.token); });

item.name: User B starts with zero projects

exec: pm.test('new user has no projects', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

item.name: User B starts with zero tasks

exec: pm.test('new user has no tasks', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

pm.test('owner login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerToken', body.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', body.token); });
pm.test('assigned member removal is blocked', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('PROJECT_MEMBER_HAS_TASKS'); });
pm.test('t2 is unassigned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().assigneeId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('t5 is reassigned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().assigneeId).to.eql('u1'); });

item.name: Add User B and remove cleared member

exec: pm.test('membership update succeeds after assignments are cleared', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().memberIds).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('userBId')); });

item.name: Login User B after membership grant

exec: pm.test('User B login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const token = pm.response.json().token; pm.collectionVariables.set('userBToken', token); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', token); });
pm.test('only shared project is visible', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const ids = pm.response.json().map(project => project.id); pm.expect(ids).to.eql(['p1']); });

pm.test('shared project tasks are visible', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const tasks = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(tasks.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(tasks.every(task => task.projectId === 'p1')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('project is non-disclosing', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('PROJECT_NOT_FOUND'); });
pm.test('task is non-disclosing', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('TASK_NOT_FOUND'); });
pm.test('non-member cannot mutate task', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('TASK_NOT_FOUND'); });

pm.test('task project is immutable', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('IMMUTABLE_FIELD'); pm.expect(error.details).to.eql(['projectId']); });

pm.test('owner login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const token = pm.response.json().token; pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerToken', token); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', token); });

item.name: Remove User B with no assigned tasks

exec: pm.test('User B removal succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().memberIds).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('userBId')); });

pm.test('removed user account remains valid', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const token = pm.response.json().token; pm.collectionVariables.set('userBToken', token); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', token); });

item.name: Removed User B projects are empty

exec: pm.test('project access is revoked', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Removed User B tasks are empty

exec: pm.test('task access is revoked', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Removed User B p1 read returns 404

exec: pm.test('revoked project is non-disclosing', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: Removed User B t1 read returns 404

exec: pm.test('revoked task is non-disclosing', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: Removed User B remains in registered directory

exec: pm.test('directory still contains User B', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(user => user.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('userBId'))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('owner cleanup login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', pm.response.json().token); });
pm.test('seed membership is restored', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('t2 assignment is restored', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('t5 assignment is restored', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
